title: Niaid blueprint compliant schema 0.5.3 template schema
description: Niaid blueprint compliant schema 0.5.3 template schema generated by the CEDAR Template Editor 2.9.5

propertyDescriptions.items: Person(s) and/or organization(s) responsible for the creation of the digital object. Both organizations and users may be specified, each as often as appropriate.
propertyDescriptions.identifier: A globally unique, persistent, machine resolvable identifier (GUPRI) assigned to the digital object.
propertyDescriptions.name: Descriptive title or name of the digital object.
propertyDescriptions.description: A description of the digital object.
propertyDescriptions.dateCreated: The date on which the digital object was created, or if that is not known, date the item was added to a data repository.
propertyDescriptions.funding: Grant or contract number(s) or other identifier(s) associated with funding the digital object.
propertyDescriptions.measurementTechnique: Technique(s) or technologies used to make measurements in the digital object. Selected from NCIT concepts under Method, Laboratory Procedure, and Disease Screening.
propertyDescriptions.distribution: Link(s) to a downloadable distribution of the digital object. Provide links that resolve to the host page for the bit stream, file, or collection of the digital object; if there is no host page, provide the direct link to download the digital object.
propertyDescriptions.citation: Link(s) to citations or references to another creative work related to the digital object. This can include a publication that describes the digital object, a publication that makes use of the digital object, or a collection that includes the digital object.
propertyDescriptions.conditionsOfAccess: The condition(s) under which the digital object can be accessed, including data use agreements or limitations. May be specified as one or more IRIs linking to the conditions of access. (Broad categories of access are expressed by the vocabularies COAR (https://vocabularies.coar-repositories.org/access_rights/) and EuroVoc's Access RIght concept (https://op.europa.eu/en/web/eu-vocabularies/concept-scheme/-/resource?uri=http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/access-right).)
propertyDescriptions.funder: Organization(s) providing funding for the digital object, expressed as Research Organization Resource(s) (RORs).
propertyDescriptions.License(s): License(s) under which the digital object is distributed. Licenses can be specified as SPDX identifiers ('Selection'), other 'Generic' IRIs identifying/pointing to licenses, or free text description ('Terms').
propertyDescriptions.Author(s): Person(s) and/or organization(s) responsible for the creation of the digital object. Both users and organizations may be independently specified, each as often as appropriate.
propertyDescriptions.type: Content type of the digital object being described (e.g., dataset, software application, image; a type of schema.org CreativeWork)
propertyDescriptions.infectiousAgent: Infectious agent(s) involved in the digital object.
propertyDescriptions.healthCondition: Health condition(s) referenced in the digital object. Selected from MONDO's disease susceptibility, injury, and human disease branches.
propertyDescriptions.host: Host organism(s) associated with the digital object.
propertyDescriptions.Spatial Coverage: The geographic area covered by the digital object. Each set of 4 fields describes one geospatial location. The total area covered is the union of all the sets.
propertyDescriptions.Temporal Coverage: Period of time represented by a digital object. Multiple intervals may be specified. User may enter any or all of the 4 fields for each interval, depending on the relevance of each field.

propertyDescriptions.applicableLocation: A representation of spatial coverage using shapes or  geometries, such as polygons or regions, using the Well-Known Text (WKT) specification (https://docs.ogc.org/is/12-063r5/12-063r5.html#30). Each entry represents a separate WKT-defined geographic area. (3-dimensional areas may also be specified; see the specification.)
propertyDescriptions.geo: A set of longitude and latitude coordinates in decimal degrees representing a geographic coverage. Negative values correspond to western longitude and southern latitudes. More than one pair of points within an entry represents a shape (2 points a line, 3 points a triangle, and so on), with points forming a clockwise closed contained with contents on the right side. Multiple points or shapes are represented by multiple entries.
propertyDescriptions.addressCountry: Identifier for a country representing geospatial coverage of the digital object.
propertyDescriptions.containedInPlace: An identifier for a geospatial region, such as a city, county, or geospatial feature. Identifiers are taken from the GAZ gazetteer.
